preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of kinds of pairs of brackets k must be between 1 and n.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= abs(s[i]) <= k for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in the string s must be an integer with absolute value between 1 and k.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= abs(t) <= k for query in queries if query[0] == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, the index i must be within bounds and t must be a valid bracket type.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for query in queries if query[0] == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, the indices l and r must be within bounds and l must be less than or equal to r.

postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, output 'Yes' if the substring is a correct bracket sequence, otherwise output 'No'.
